verses.text: The LORD speaks to Cyrus, the one he anointed. “I've taken your right hand to bring nations down before you and strip kings of their armor, to open doors ahead of you and keep the gates from closing.
I'll go ahead of you and smooth out the rough places. I'll smash bronze doors and cut iron bars apart.
I'll give you treasure kept in the dark and riches hidden away, so you'll know I'm the LORD, Israel's God, the one who calls you by name.
For Jacob my servant and Israel my chosen one, I called you by name and gave you a title even though you didn't know me.
I'm the LORD. There's no one else. There's no God besides me. I'll make you strong even though you haven't known me,
so people from where the sun rises to where it sets will know there's no one besides me. I'm the LORD, and there's no one else.
I shape the light and create darkness. I make peace and bring calamity. I'm the LORD, the one who does all of it.
Heavens, let it rain from above! Skies, pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up and grow salvation, with righteousness springing up alongside it. I, the LORD, created it.

Trouble for anybody who picks a fight with their maker, a clay pot among all the clay pots on the ground! Does clay ask the person shaping it, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘You don't even have hands’?
Trouble for the one who asks a father, ‘What kind of child did you father?’ or asks a mother, ‘What did you give birth to?’”
The LORD, the Holy One of Israel and the one who made Israel, says, “You ask me what's coming for my children, and then you try to boss me around about what my hands have made!
I made the earth and created people to live on it. My own hands stretched out the heavens, and I gave orders to all their armies.
I raised him up in righteousness and I'll straighten all his roads. He'll build my city and let my exiles go free without taking payment or a reward,” says the LORD of Armies.

The LORD says, “Egypt's wealth from its work and Ethiopia's goods will come over to you, along with the tall Sabeans. They'll belong to you and follow you, coming over in chains. They'll bow down and plead with you, ‘God really is with you. There's no one else. There is no other god.
You truly are a God who hides himself, God of Israel, the one who saves.’”
They'll all end up ashamed and confused. The people making idols will go off disgraced together.
But the LORD will save Israel with a salvation that lasts forever. You won't be put to shame or left humiliated, ever.
The LORD made the heavens. He's the God who shaped the earth and set it firm. He made it for people to live in and didn't create it to sit empty. He says, “I am the LORD. There is no other.
I didn't speak in secret from some dark corner of the land. I didn't tell Jacob's children, ‘Look for me and you'll get nowhere.’ I, the LORD, speak what's right and declare what's true.
“Gather together, you who've escaped from the nations. Come close. People who haul around wooden idols and pray to a god that can't save them don't know what they're doing.

Say what you've got to say and make your case. Get together and talk it over. Who showed this from ancient times? Who announced it back then? Wasn't it me, the LORD? There is no other God besides me. I'm a just God and a Savior. There's no one besides me.
“Look to me and be saved, all you at the ends of the earth. I am God, and there is no other.
I've sworn by my own name. I've spoken a righteous word and won't take it back. Every knee will bow to me, and every tongue will swear an oath.
They'll say about me, ‘Only in the LORD are righteousness and strength.’” People will come to him, and everyone who raged against him will end up ashamed.
All of Israel's descendants will be made right in the LORD, and they'll celebrate!
